critical_code_review_comments: EnterprisePortal.jsx L34-43 — the `{ silent }` option pattern is idiomatic and minimal. The mount-level `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` still calls the loud (non-silent) load, so the initial full-screen loader is preserved. All child-triggered reloads (MemberList, SeatEditorModal, post-checkout fulfillment via useEffect on searchParams) go through the silent path — good.

Post-checkout fulfillment (L57-71) still calls the LOUD `load()` after a successful seat purchase. That is intentional and correct since the user is returning from an external redirect and the full-screen loader is expected UX. No change needed.

MemberList.jsx unchanged as expected — tempCreds still lives locally. This works ONLY because the parent no longer unmounts the component during reload. If a future refactor reverts the parent to a loud reload, this bug will silently reappear. Consider adding a code comment on tempCreds explaining the invariant (parent must silent-reload).

SeatEditorModal receives onSuccess={() => load({silent:true})} — good. The modal already calls onClose() before onSuccess() in applySeatChange (L44-45), so the modal's own state does not depend on surviving the reload (unlike MemberList.tempCreds did). Correct.
No console errors, no React warnings, no infinite-render logs observed on any surface during this run.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-22 HIGH regression (TempCredsModal not rendering after createUserDirect) is FIXED and verified. The fix is a 3-line change in EnterprisePortal.jsx: `load()` accepts `{silent:true}` and only sets `loading=true` on the initial load; MemberList + SeatEditorModal onReload callbacks pass silent:true so mid-flow child-owned state (tempCreds, seat preview) survives the reload. Fresh org test creds are in test_credentials above — reuse them for future runs or provision a new one via POST /api/admin/orgs (super_admin). No further action needed on this regression path.
rca of the issue: Iter-22 root cause was `EnterprisePortal.load()` unconditionally calling `setLoading(true)` on every invocation. Combined with the L79 early-return `<Loader />` when loading is true, ALL descendant components unmounted on every dashboard refresh. Post-split, child-owned state (MemberList.tempCreds) got destroyed before the TempCredsModal could paint. Iter-23 fix: `load({silent=false} = {})` now only sets `loading=true` when `!silent`; parent passes `onReload={() => load({silent:true})}` to MemberList and `onSuccess={() => load({silent:true})}` to SeatEditorModal. Initial mount still uses the loud path so the first-paint spinner UX is preserved. Verified end-to-end via Playwright: submit-create-user → temp-creds-modal renders in <8s → email + password textContent match server response → new member row present in dashboard after silent refresh.
